Risk factors. The company depends on a limited number of suppliers in Asia for key components. A disruption of the supply chain, tariffs or export restrictions could reduce product availability and raise costs.

Legal proceedings. The company is subject to antitrust investigations in the European Union concerning App Store payment rules, which could result in fines or required changes to its business model.

Liquidity. The company holds cash and marketable securities and repurchased shares during the quarter under its buyback program.
